svg.title: Luxury fusion house with arches, glass and brass
svg.desc: A luxury house that blends traditional Pakistani arches with modern glass: a double-height pointed-arch glass atrium with brass lattice, a ground-floor arcade of round arches, brass-finned first-floor windows, a jali parapet band, boxwood planters, cypress trees and a charcoal gate with brass inlay under soft overcast light.
